knobs.name: capture_before_xmit

L2-4: event dpWriter.FileWritten count == 2 with different names
L2-7: event dpWriter.FileWritten count == 1 over the whole test (Q and D)

knobs.mechanism: piCamera.CAPTURE() is inserted before dpCat.BUILD_CATALOG: one more product is stored than the test made; whether it is also sent depends on timing and is not judged; the downlink outlasts one capture (about a minute per product over the radio), so its dpWriter.FileWritten falls inside the window

knobs.name: extra_noop

L2-8: event cmdDisp.NoOpReceived count == 1 during the downlink

knobs.mechanism: cmdDisp.CMD_NO_OP() is sent twice in a row (inserted copy): one more command is served than the test expects
